#### CNS:

+---------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Premedication       | - Slow onset (30 mins)                                         |
|                     | - Long duration (3-7 hours)                                    |
|                     | - Variable duration (CYP2D6 polymorphism)                      |
|                     | - No amnesia                                                   |
+---------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| General anaesthesia | - Partial agonist → ceiling effect, insufficient as sole agent |
|                     | - Prolonged hypotension                                        |
|                     | - Delayed emergence                                            |
+---------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Systemic analgesia  | - Sedation unwanted                                            |
|                     | - Rebound agitation and hypertension with prolonged use        |
|                     |   - Requires weaning                                           |
+---------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Neuraxial analgesia | - Prolonged blockade → inability to monitor motor function     |
+---------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+

#### CVS:

+------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
| Reflex suppressant     | - Prolonged effect may be unwanted                       |
|                        |   - Laryngoscopy                                         |
|                        |   - Surgery                                              |
|                        | - Unable to titrate – bolus cf. infusion                 |
+------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
| Myocardial ischaemia   | - Hypotension impairs myocardial oxygen supply           |
+------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
| Opioid withdrawal      | - Does not prevent psychological craving                 |
+------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
| Essential hypertension | - α~2~ adrenoceptor upregulation – not for prolonged use |
+------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
